source.check: returned unopposed: named in column 6 ('Names of Candidates Elected') with no votes in column 5, where no poll was taken, in the Returning Officer's notice of result dated 5 June 1958 (Ulster Star, 7 June 1958, p. 9; read on the BNA page image)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polling day Thursday 5 June 1958. There was no poll: the Returning Officer's notice of result dated 5 June 1958 (Ulster Star, 7 June 1958, p. 9) names one member elected for each of the sixteen divisions, none with votes recorded. The Belfast News-Letter (21 May 1958, p. 11) had reported fifteen nominations for fifteen seats; the official notice lists sixteen (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Printed 'Robert Bennett Morow' in column 6 and 'MORROW, Robert Bennett' in columns 2-3. Returned unopposed.
